fusions.name: Hind Kick
fusions.desc: A quick kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2s after you use it.

fusions.name: Bolt and Strike
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 12 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Warren Sprint
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 50% for 6 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Hare's Heels
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 14%.
